content: {"praised":["Strong, witty dialogue keeps viewers engaged.","Intense, brutal violence and action typical of Western genre.","Powerful theme music sets a dramatic tone.","Timeless acting, especially Timothy Olyphant’s charismatic performance.","Complex characters, neither wholly good nor bad."],"criticized":["Poor characterization and unrealistic plot twists.","Lousy script writing and contradictory actions.","Predictable storyline, losing original edge.","Turns into sitcom-like feel, lacking tension.","No cliffhangers, dull pacing."]}
